input: Gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs) at multiple resolutions (10x, 20x, 40x)
output: Multi-resolution WSI representations, cancer subtype classification, tissue phenotyping, Visual Question Answering (VQA), caption generation, and pathology report generation
notable: Proposes a Multi-Resolution Pyramid Transformer (MRPT) with Consecutive Cross-Resolution Attention (CCRA) for hierarchical multi-scale feature learning, and extends it to MRPT-LLaVA for multimodal WSI understanding.
